name: kxaaagasw
title: Will the US average regular gas price be above $4.56 on Oct 12, 2026?
settlement: If the average regular gas price for the United States is strictly greater than $4.5600 on Oct 12, 2026 according to AAA, the market resolves to Yes. Resolution uses AAA's national daily average retail gasoline price for that specific date.
decideContext: You are estimating the effect of news on the AAA national average regular gasoline retail price (USD/gal) as of Oct 12, 2026, which determines whether it settles above the $4.56 strike.
